_comment: Tier-2 for skfem hyperelasticity#0, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. Claim: skfem ships no hyperelastic model and the only elasticity helper is linear_elasticity. Ran: probed 13 hyperelastic model names against skfem.models.elasticity and the skfem top level, and assembled linear_elasticity on ElementVector(ElementTriP1) over MeshTri().refined(2). Printed: `from skfem.models.elasticity import neohookean` raises ImportError('cannot import name neohookean from skfem.models.elasticity'); all 13 names absent from both namespaces; models.elasticity's public surface is exactly BilinearForm/ddot/eye/lame_parameters/linear_elasticity/linear_stress/plane_stress/sym_grad/trace; linear_elasticity assembles a 50x50 symmetric matrix with 480 non-zeros and gives an IDENTICAL matrix at a deformed state, i.e. it is state-independent and cannot stand in for a hyperelastic law.
